title: 'one of the most inspiring books I've read in 2026' — Antwerp Management School's Geert Scheipers puts Incorruptible on his personal strategy canon
summary: Scheipers teaches the Strategy Management module on GUBERNA's Director Effectiveness Programme — GUBERNA is the Belgian institute for board directors — and the participants asked him for his personal reading list. The list he published names eleven books and is otherwise a strategy canon: Christensen's The Innovator's Dilemma, Rumelt's The Crux, Lafley and Martin's Playing to Win, Grant's Contemporary Strategy Analysis. Incorruptible is on it, cited in full academic form and credited to the colleague who gave it to him. He describes the selection as books that shaped his thinking and that he returns to in teaching and practice.
blockquote: a personal selection of books that have shaped my thinking, challenged some of my assumptions, and that I regularly return to in my teaching and practice … thanks for one of the most inspiring books I've read in 2026
attribution_title: Professor of Strategy Management & Academic Director, Antwerp Management School

type_metadata.audience: 40 reactions; taught on GUBERNA's Director Effectiveness Programme
